messages:
irene_cust: Hey — after the blue/green rollout this morning the assistant started ignoring the system prompt once the convo grows. Previously it executed system instructions reliably. Now after ~6k tokens it just switches tone and drops the system constraints. Repro steps below, this is affecting a paying customer.
jess_support: Thanks for reporting, Irene. Can you paste the request_id and the model variant you hit? Also did you see any API error codes or latency spikes?
irene_cust: request_id=req_0a1b2c3d4e, model=redwood-2-large-quant (we were on redwood-2 before). No HTTP errors, responses are 200 but content deviates. p95 latency ~420ms, p99 ~1.3s. Repro curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{
    "model":"redwood-2-large-quant",
    "messages":[
      {"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant. Always format answers as numbered steps."},
      {"role":"user","content":"I have a long conversation history... (repeat to reach ~6200 tokens)"}
    ],
    "max_tokens":512
  }'
```
irene_cust: After the thread grows, the assistant returns normal content but drops the numbered steps and starts freeform responses. Happened after rollout at ~15:45 UTC.
deploy_bot: deploy: redwood/runtime v2.14.0 -> prod @ 2026-03-10T15:45:12Z (canary -> all)
sam_eng-ml: @jess_support thanks, looking. A couple quick q's: is KV cache enabled for this tenant and are you using streaming? any truncation headers? Also can you share the exact token counts for the messages before the failure?
jess_support: Irene said KV caching = default (enabled). Streaming = disabled. I'll ask for exact token counts.
irene_cust: Token count before drop was ~6200 total input tokens (we've been running 8k windows historically). This only appeared after the upgrade. We rolled back to redwood-2 (non-quant) and behavior returned to expected immediately.
sam_eng-ml: Repro steps sound clear. I can reproduce locally with redwood-2-large-quant: after ~6k input tokens the system role effect is absent in generated text. No error logs, just abrupt semantic shift. My current hypothesis: an aggressive early eviction in the KV/prefix cache for quantized runtime, causing system prompt to be evicted from active context earlier than before. Possible regression in the cache index or sequence mapping after the kernel swap in v2.14.0.
sam_eng-ml: Quick mitigation: pin customers to redwood-2 (non-quant) until we patch, or force shorter context windows (<=5k) or send the system prompt as the last user message as a temporary hack (not ideal). I'll open an ENG-ML ticket with reproducer + trace.
alex_prod: Noted. We should notify impacted customers and offer immediate pinning. Jess, can you coordinate comms? Sam, prioritize a canary rollback plan if this impacts more tenants.
jess_support: Will draft an outbound note and offer to pin them to the previous model. Irene, we can pin you now — want us to do that?
irene_cust: Yes please pin to redwood-2 for now. Thanks.
sam_eng-ml: FWIW traces show KV index lookups succeed but the token-to-kv mapping appears to shift at certain chunk boundaries after quantized attention switch. I suspect a boundary off-by-one in compressed KV chunking. Filing bug and attaching reproducer+trace.
sam_eng-ml: Action items: (1) ENG-ML: investigate KV chunking boundary fix (priority P0), (2) ENG-RUNTIME: review v2.14.0 kernel swap for quantized attention, (3) Support/Product: offer pinning & customer comms.
jess_support: Created support ticket SUP-2026-1456 and applied model pin for Irene's org. Draft comms ready, will send after legal review. :+1:
alex_prod: Good. Sam, please add estimated time-to-fix and whether a rollback is warranted. Tag eng-runtime.
sam_eng-ml: Will update within 2 hours. For now workaround and pin in place. :eyes:
irene_cust: Appreciate the quick help — the regression was blocking some scheduled demos. Please keep me posted.
jess_support: Will do. Escalating full logs and reproducer to eng-ml now. :warning:
